description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the land acquired in Udupila, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including location details (province, district, village), plot numbers, land names, extents, and compensation amounts deposited in court. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
